summary: Purpose: buffer against shocks (West Asia war, oil spikes, supply-chain disruption); corpus **₹1 lakh crore**

items: Purpose: buffer against shocks (West Asia war, oil spikes, supply-chain disruption); corpus **₹1 lakh crore**

blocks.content: 💼 Interview Q → *Why an Economic Stabilisation Fund now?* → Fiscal headroom to absorb West Asia-driven shocks (oil, supply chains) without derailing the budgeted fiscal deficit — a contingency buffer, not new spending.
🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — Total corpus (₹1 lakh crore) vs cash component (~₹57,000 crore) trap pairing.
